title: Settings
showToolCallsDesc: Display tool invocation blocks in chat
showToolResultsDesc: Display tool execution results in chat
showThinkingDesc: Display AI reasoning process in chat
collapseThinkingDesc: Auto-collapse thinking blocks once streaming completes
showTimelineDesc: Display activity timeline in the message area
retryEnabledDesc: Automatically retry on model API errors (rate limit, timeout, 5xx)
retryMaxRetriesDesc: Maximum number of retry attempts on failure
retryBaseDelayDesc: Initial wait time before the first retry
retryMaxDelayDesc: Upper limit for exponential backoff delay
